figurative_meaning_en: Being in a state of blissful immersion or ecstasy from enjoyment
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সুন্দর গান শুনে রসেবশে থেকে গেল।
পার্টিতে সবাই খাবারের রসে রসেবশে থাকল।
example_sentences_in_english: He was lost in ecstasy listening to the beautiful song.
Everyone at the party was blissfully immersed in the flavors of the food.
history: References a line from a folk or devotional song lyric 'রাখিস মা রসেবশে', evoking emotional or spiritual rapture in Bengali tradition.
note: The idiom draws from the concept of 'rasa' in aesthetics, common in Bengali arts and poetry.
